name: @red-cup-engineering/rdf-services-section
description: Holds the in-memory RDF model and algorithms — term construction, named-graph quad-set assembly, N-Quads serialization, and RDFC-1.0 canonicalization — extracted from the WitnessJournal RDF projection service as self-contained, single-capability packages. Use when a consumer needs RDF term validation, a quad set, N-Quads text, or a canonical digest without pulling in WitnessJournal's settlement-specific encoding.
